'''Assistant Manager''' was a position in the governmental structure of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the position was held by [[Kelmut Wolg]].
